introduction_markdown: Épreuve à choix multiples (Special Bilingual Education French 1, juin 2025). Répondez à toutes les 50 questions ; chaque question vaut un point. Quatre alternatives (A, B, C, D) sont proposées, une seule est correcte. Les téléphones mobiles sont strictement interdits dans la salle de composition. Durée : une heure trente minutes.
enonce_intro_markdown: **Questions à choix multiples** - choisissez la seule bonne réponse, A, B, C ou D.
incertitudes: Scan photocopié avec filigrane : tout est lisible ; les blancs imprimés sont écrits « ____ ». Le sujet ne compte que 5 pages, 50 questions (1 à 35 Français intensif et ECM, 36 à 50 EPS).

Q28, Q42 et Q45 converties en questions ouvertes : deux réponses défendables ou clé non établissable avec certitude (Q28 rôle principal de la société civile : exercer la pression / défendre les opprimés / éduquer ; Q42 aire de lancer du poids : la zone de chute ou le butoir ; Q45 phase du saut en hauteur : décollage ou impulsion).

Clés retenues mais discutables : Q4 (les leur, accord de « envoyé » ignoré dans le sujet), Q21 (armoiries / symboles nationaux), Q29 (session inaugurale), Q34 (fiduciaire / en papier), Q36 (disqualifié, règle actuelle ; l'ancien carton jaune est écarté), Q37 (de vitesse / de sprint court), Q41 (butoir), Q49 (trépied famille des renversements, vocabulaire du programme camerounais d'EPS).
Corrigés rédigés sans corrigé officiel, notamment les faits civiques et sportifs (Q21 à Q50) : à faire relire.
Converties en questions ouvertes par le relecteur (clé ou options discutables) : 28, 42, 45.

questions.enonce_markdown:
**FRANÇAIS INTENSIF**

Quand il fait chaud, il est conseillé de boire ____ eau chaude.
questions.corrige_markdown: With a partitive meaning (some water) before a vowel, French uses "de l’" after "boire": "boire de l’eau". "L’" would be a definite article (the water), and "une" / "d’une" would mean one particular quantity. Rule: partitive article = du, de la, de l’ (before a vowel). **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Lucie est ____ en première année à l’université de Buea.
questions.corrige_markdown: Lucie is a girl at university, so the feminine noun "étudiante" is needed. "Élève" is used for school pupils, "étudiant" is masculine, and "finissante" means a final-year student. Rule: a university learner is an "étudiant(e)", agreeing in gender with the person. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: Le groupe a adopté la solution ____ vous avez proposée.
questions.corrige_markdown: The relative pronoun is the direct object of "avez proposée" (vous avez proposé la solution), so "que" is correct. "Dont" replaces a complement introduced by "de", "laquelle" needs a preposition, and "donc" is a conjunction. Rule: "que" = direct-object relative pronoun. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Maman a envoyé trente mille francs à ses enfants. Elle ____ a envoyé il y a trois jours.
questions.corrige_markdown: Two object pronouns are needed: "les" (the francs, direct object) and "leur" (to the children, indirect object). With a direct object of the third person, the order is "les" then "leur": "Elle les leur a envoyé". "Leurs" with an s is a possessive, and "leur les" has the wrong order. Rule: le/la/les come before lui/leur. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Les bandits ont été ____ au commissariat.
questions.corrige_markdown: In the passive (ont été + past participle), the participle agrees with the subject "les bandits" (masculine plural): "conduits". "Conduire" is the infinitive, "conduit" is singular. Rule: the past participle after être agrees with the subject. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Nous étions très occupés pendant les deux ____ semaines du mois.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Semaines" is feminine plural, so the ordinal adjective must be "premières" (the first two weeks of the month). "Derniers" and "premiers" are masculine, and "précédentes" (previous) does not fit with "du mois". Rule: ordinal numbers agree in gender and number, and come before the cardinal number in French ("les deux premières semaines"). **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Le public souhaite que vous ____ une nouvelle chanson.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Souhaiter que" is followed by the subjunctive. The present subjunctive of "interpréter" with "vous" is "interprétiez" (with the ending -iez). "Interprétez" is the indicative or imperative, and "avez interprété" and "aurez interprété" are indicative tenses. Rule: verbs of wish + que + subjunctive. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Ma famille et moi vous ____ de votre bonne compréhension.
questions.corrige_markdown: The subject "Ma famille et moi" is equivalent to "nous", so the verb ends in -ons: "remercions". "Remercient" is third person plural, "remercie" and "remercies" are singular. Rule: a subject made of "X et moi" takes the first person plural. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Une ____ de personnes était à la fête.
questions.corrige_markdown: A collective noun meaning about a hundred is needed, and the verb "était" is singular, so the noun is "centaine" (feminine singular). "Centaines" is plural, "centime" is a coin and "centième" is an ordinal. Rule: une centaine de + plural noun. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: Je vais l’éconduire, à moins que vous ne me le ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: "À moins que" requires the subjunctive. The present subjunctive of "déconseiller" with "vous" is "déconseilliez". "Déconseillez" is the indicative, "déconseiller" the infinitive and "déconseilleriez" the conditional. Rule: à moins que + subjunctive. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Je ne boirais pas de cette eau ____ rafraîchissante qu’elle soit.
questions.corrige_markdown: Before an adjective ("rafraîchissante"), the concessive expression is "quelque ... que" with "quelque" invariable (meaning "however"). "Quel que" and "quelle que" are used before a verb (quelle que soit la raison). Rule: quelque + adjective + que + subjunctive. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - grammaire et conjugaison

questions.enonce_markdown: Ma sœur est médecin, elle est très <u>hospitalière</u>. Le mot souligné signifie qu’elle ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Hospitalier(ère)" describes a person who welcomes guests warmly, so it means "très accueillante". It is not "hostile" (the opposite), and the word does not mean owning a hotel or admitting patients, even though the sister is a doctor. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - vocabulaire

questions.enonce_markdown: "It never rains but it pours" peut se traduire en français par :
questions.corrige_markdown: The English proverb means that misfortunes rarely come singly. The French equivalent is "Un malheur n’arrive jamais seul". The other options translate the words literally and lose the figurative meaning. Rule: translate a proverb by its idiomatic equivalent, not word for word. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais

choix.texte: Il ne pleut jamais mais il y a des averses.
Il n’a jamais de malheur sans pluie.

questions.enonce_markdown: "Mary seldom drinks beer" peut se traduire en français par :
questions.corrige_markdown: "Seldom" means "hardly ever", which is "ne ... guère". After a negation of quantity, the partitive becomes "de": "ne boit guère de bière". "Jamais" means never and "pas" is a plain negation; option D wrongly keeps the definite article. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais

choix.texte: Mary ne boit jamais de bière.
Mary ne boit pas de bière.
Mary ne boit guère de bière.
Mary ne boit guère la bière.

questions.enonce_markdown: "You cannot serve two masters at a time". Peut se traduire en français par :
questions.corrige_markdown: The proverb is translated faithfully by "On ne peut pas servir deux maîtres à la fois". Option A is a different proverb (chasing two hares), C weakens "cannot" to "difficult" and changes "masters" to "bosses", and D changes the verb and the object. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - traduction vers le francais

choix.texte: On ne poursuit pas deux lièvres à la fois.
On ne peut pas servir deux maîtres à la fois.
Il est difficile de servir deux patrons à la fois.
On ne peut pas suivre deux chemins à la fois

questions.enonce_markdown: La biographie est la ____ d’un auteur.
questions.corrige_markdown: A biography is the written account of the life of a person: "la vie d’un auteur". "Librairie" is a bookshop, and the other nouns are not what the word "biographie" (bio = life, graphie = writing) means. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - civilisation et culture

questions.enonce_markdown: Une œuvre autobiographique est une œuvre qui parle de la vie ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: In an autobiographical work, the author writes about his or her own life ("auto" = self). So the work talks about the life of the author. The other options refer to a character or to one particular writer. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - civilisation et culture

questions.enonce_markdown: Les robots travaillent comme des hommes. La figure de style dans cette phrase est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The sentence links two things with the comparison word "comme", so the figure of speech is a comparison. A metaphor has no comparison word, an oxymoron joins two opposite words, and a periphrase replaces a word by a long expression. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - litterature

questions.enonce_markdown: Le ____ est un genre littéraire.
questions.corrige_markdown: The novel is a literary genre (with poetry, theatre, the essay...). A book is an object, a chapter is a part of a book and a text is a general word. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - litterature

questions.enonce_markdown: Des genres littéraires ci-après, lequel peut être joué ?
questions.corrige_markdown: Theatre is written to be performed on stage by actors, so it is the genre that can be played. A letter, a poem and an essay are read. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - litterature

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Education à la Citoyenneté et à la Morale**

L’ensemble des signes, devises et ornements de l’Etat constitue les ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The coat of arms (les armoiries) is the set of signs, mottos and ornaments that represent the State, and it is one of the national symbols. "Devises" are only the mottos, and "archives" are records. The wording of the question points to "armoiries" as the specific term. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: La ville de Tiko est située dans le département ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Tiko is a coastal town in the South-West Region of Cameroon, in the Fako Division (near Limbe and Buea). Meme (capital Kumba), Manyu (Mamfe) and Ndian (Mundemba) are other divisions of the same region. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Lorsque le drapeau est ____, on dit qu’il est en berne.
questions.corrige_markdown: A flag "en berne" is flown at half-mast as a sign of mourning, so it is hoisted only part of the way up the pole. At the top it is the normal position. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Un ____ jouit des droits civiques et politiques dans un Etat et est soumis à des devoirs.
questions.corrige_markdown: A citizen is a person who enjoys civil and political rights in a State and has duties towards it. A prisoner, a foreigner or a refugee do not have the full set of civic and political rights. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Les chefs traditionnels sont des ____ de l’administration.
questions.corrige_markdown: In Cameroon, traditional rulers are "auxiliaires de l’administration": they help the State administration to carry out its work at community level, without being civil servants. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le ____ est l’organe chargé d’assister les communes dans la gestion de leur budget.
questions.corrige_markdown: FEICOM (Fonds Spécial d’Equipement et d’Intervention Intercommunale) is the Cameroonian body that finances and assists councils (communes) in their budgets and projects. FNE is the National Employment Fund and the Road Fund finances roads. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: « L’opération épervier » désigne ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: "Opération Épervier" is the Cameroonian anti-corruption campaign, started in 2006, in which officials suspected of embezzlement were arrested and tried. It is therefore a judicial measure to fight corruption, not a law or an encouraging measure. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

choix.texte: un article de loi adopté par le parlement
une disposition visant à limiter le détournement
une mesure judiciaire de lutte contre la corruption

questions.enonce_markdown:
____ est le rôle principal de la société civile.

*Options as printed:* A) Exercer la pression sur les décideurs   B) Parvenir au pouvoir   C) Défendre les opprimés   D) Eduquer la population
questions.corrige_markdown:
Civil society organisations (associations, NGOs, unions) mainly act as a counter-power: they put pressure on decision makers and monitor public action. Two other options are also defended in textbooks (defending the oppressed, educating the population), and the key could not be settled with certainty, so the question is left open.

**Intended answer: A (Exercer la pression sur les décideurs).**

The printed question is not reliable enough to be marked automatically so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: La session ____ est celle au cours de laquelle les députés reçoivent leurs attributs et insignes.
questions.corrige_markdown: The first session of a new legislature, when the newly elected members take up office and receive their badges and insignia, is the inaugural session ("session inaugurale"). A plenary session is a full sitting, an extraordinary session is called outside the normal calendar, and a closed session excludes the public. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le ____ est l’opération comptable consistant à muter de l’argent d’un compte bancaire à un autre.
questions.corrige_markdown: A transfer of money from one bank account to another is a "virement". A "versement" is a deposit into an account and a "paiement" is a payment for a purchase. "Transfèrement" is the transfer of a prisoner. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: La Commission Nationale du Bilinguisme et du Multiculturalisme est créée en ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The National Commission for the Promotion of Bilingualism and Multiculturalism was created by presidential decree in January 2017. The other dates are those of other events (1972: the unitary State; 1984: the name "République du Cameroun"). **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le ministère ____ met en œuvre la protection civile.
questions.corrige_markdown: Civil protection (disaster prevention and relief) is placed under the Ministry of Territorial Administration (MINAT), which has a Civil Protection Directorate. Health, Social Affairs and Justice have other missions. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le casier judiciaire est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The criminal record ("casier judiciaire") is a statement of the convictions of a given individual, issued by the court registry. It is not drawn up at the prefecture nor by the Constitutional Council, and it concerns one person, not a directory of all convictions. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

choix.texte: une pièce établie à la préfecture
un relevé des condamnations d’un individu
un document dressé par le Conseil Constitutionnel

questions.enonce_markdown: Le billet de banque est une monnaie ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Banknotes and coins are "monnaie fiduciaire" because their value rests on the confidence (fiducia) people have in the issuer. "Scripturale" money exists only as entries in bank accounts. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown: Le phénomène de l’émission des gaz par les industries provoque des ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Gases released by factories pollute the air, which directly harms the lungs and causes respiratory diseases (asthma, bronchitis). The other consequences are not the direct effect of the emission of gases. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education civique et morale

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Education Physique et Sportive**

Un athlète responsable d’un faux départ dans les courses de vitesse est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: Under the current athletics rules, a sprinter who causes a false start is disqualified immediately. There is no time penalty, the yellow card warning belongs to the old rule (now abolished), and a restart is allowed only for the other runners. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: pénalisé de plusieurs secondes à l’arrivée

questions.enonce_markdown: Le 400m est une course ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The 400 m is one of the speed races (sprint events), usually called a "course de vitesse". It is not a distance race, it is longer than the short sprints (100 m and 200 m) and it is an individual event, not a relay. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Pendant les courses en compétition officielle, un athlète est identifié par ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: In official races each athlete wears a bib number ("dossard") pinned on the vest to be identified by judges and timekeepers. Spikes and running style cannot identify a runner. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Parmi les épreuves suivantes, laquelle se pratique uniquement dans la nature ?
questions.corrige_markdown: Mountain running takes place only in natural terrain. The marathon, the half-marathon and walking races can be held on roads or in a stadium. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Dans le traçage des installations au lancer du poids, 50mm représente ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: In the marking of the shot put area, the lines (sector lines and the line around the circle) are 50 mm wide. The circle diameter is 2.135 m and the other lengths are much larger. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: la longueur du secteur de chute
le diamètre du cercle de lancer
l’épaisseur des lignes de l’aire de lancer

questions.enonce_markdown: Au lancer du poids, le butoir est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The "butoir" (stop board) is the curved board at the front of the circle which stops the thrower from stepping out of the circle towards the landing sector. The landing zone is the "secteur de chute". **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: la zone où atterrissent les masses lors des lancers
le point où la masse tombe après un jet
un dispositif qui empêche les lanceurs d’entrer dans le secteur de chute
le jet le plus lointain réalisé par un athlète durant une compétition

questions.enonce_markdown:
Lequel des éléments suivants fait partie de l’aire de lancer du poids ?

*Options as printed:* A) La lice   B) La zone de chute   C) Le décamètre   D) Le butoir
questions.corrige_markdown:
The throwing area of the shot put includes the circle, the stop board (butoir) and the landing sector. Both "la zone de chute" and "le butoir" can be read as part of the area depending on the syllabus wording, so the key could not be settled with certainty.

**Intended answer: D (Le butoir).**

The printed question is not reliable enough to be marked automatically so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Quel est le lancer lourd qui n’est pas pratiqué dans les établissements scolaires du Cameroun ?
questions.corrige_markdown: The hammer throw needs a protective cage and special equipment, so it is not practised in schools in Cameroon, where shot put, discus and javelin are taught. **Answer: B.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Les familles de sauts en athlétisme sont ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: In athletics the jumps are grouped into two families: vertical jumps (high jump, pole vault) and horizontal jumps (long jump, triple jump). The other options mix single events with families or invent families. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: le saut en longueur et les sauts verticaux
le saut oblique et les sauts transversaux
les sauts verticaux et les sauts horizontaux
les sauts verticaux et le triple saut

questions.enonce_markdown:
La phase durant laquelle un athlète prend appui sur une jambe pour franchir la barre au saut en hauteur est ____.

*Options as printed:* A) le décollage   B) l’impulsion   C) la suspension   D) l’envol
questions.corrige_markdown:
In the high jump, the athlete runs up, then pushes off one leg (impulsion, also called the take-off or "appel") before clearing the bar. "Décollage" is also close in meaning, so the key could not be settled with certainty.

**Intended answer: B (l’impulsion).**

The printed question is not reliable enough to be marked automatically so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Le rouleau ventral et le saut en ciseaux sont des techniques ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The scissors jump and the western (ventral) roll are classic techniques of the high jump. They are not gymnastic vaults, piked jumps or long-jump styles. **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

questions.enonce_markdown: Au saut en hauteur, les supports permettent ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The uprights (supports) of the high jump hold the crossbar at the chosen height. They do not help the take-off, the grip of the spikes or the counting of strides. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: d’augmenter l’adhérence des pointes au sol
de mesurer le nombre de foulées avant de sauter

questions.enonce_markdown: En gymnastique artistique, la table de saut est ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: The vaulting table is used in competition by both men and women, so it is a mixed apparatus. It is not reserved for one sex and it is an official competition apparatus. **Answer: C.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: un agrès qu’on utilise uniquement pour s’entraîner

questions.enonce_markdown: A quelle famille d’éléments gymniques appartient le trépied ?
questions.corrige_markdown: The tripod (trépied) is a balance element in which the body is inverted and supported on the hands and the head. In school gymnastics it belongs to the family of the "renversements" (inversions). **Answer: A.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive

choix.texte: La famille des ouvertures et des fermetures

questions.enonce_markdown: Pendant la réalisation d’un élément tel que l’ATR, le corps s’équilibre sur ____.
questions.corrige_markdown: ATR (appui tendu renversé) is the handstand: the body is upside down and balances on the two hands, so on two manual supports. Foot supports are used for standing positions. **Answer: D.**
themes: O Level SBE French - education physique et sportive
